tests.question: How does my contacts app stop one user from seeing someone else's people?
tests.expected_answer: Postgres Row Level Security: every policy allows a row only if its user_id equals auth.user_id() from the signed-in user's JWT, so the database (not the UI) enforces it.

expected_sources.section: Authentication and ownership > The ownership rule
expected_sources.passage: Every policy says the same thing: you may touch a row only if its user_id equals your own id.
